audit.title: Audit log
audit.note: Every row is shown as the system recorded it, newest first, for the clinics you audit. Nothing here can be changed.
audit.filterHint: All filters are optional. Leave a box empty to not filter on it.
audit.zoneHint: Dates are in your browser's time zone.
audit.end: That is the end of the log for this search.

register.title: Register a patient
register.hint: Search first. Register only when the person is not found. The details are not kept on this page after saving.
register.confirmBody: This saves the name, date of birth and phone you typed, encrypted, at this clinic. If they match an existing record, that record is used instead of a new one.
register.conflict: A different person was already saved with this request. Check the details and register again.
register.unavailable: Registering is not set up yet (encryption keys are not configured). Nothing was saved.
register.invalid: One of the fields is not valid. Check the date of birth and the phone number. Nothing was saved.
register.notFound: This clinic could not be found, or you are not front desk there. Nothing was saved.

outcome.matched: This person matched an existing record.
outcome.review: Possible matches were found. Nothing was linked automatically; a person decides.
outcome.replayed: This request had already been saved. Nothing new was created.
outcome.unknown: The system answered, but the outcome is not one this screen knows. Open the record to check.

register.name: Name to register

full.title: Full details
full.audited: Opening this shows the name, date of birth and phone, and is recorded in the audit log (who, role and which record, never the contents).
full.unavailable: The full details cannot be opened in this setup. Nothing was shown.
full.rateLimited: Too many records opened in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.

run.title: Run this referral?
run.body: This queues the Front Door run for this document. It does not message the patient. Any red flag it finds arrives as a task for a person.
run.replayed: This request had already queued a run. Job:
run.unavailable: Runs cannot be started yet (not set up). Nothing was queued.
run.notFound: This referral could not be found. Nothing was queued.

erasure.title: Erasure requests
erasure.note: Erasing a patient's identity takes two front desk people: one asks and a different one approves. Each step needs a fresh authenticator code.
erasure.actionsOff: Asking, approving and cancelling are switched off until the second-factor check is confirmed. The list below is read-only.
erasure.hasMore: There are more requests than are shown.
erasure.requested: The request was made. A different front desk person must approve it.
erasure.reasonsNotSetUp: The clinic's list of erasure reasons is not set up yet, so a request cannot be made from here. Nothing was sent.
erasure.requestBody: Nothing is erased yet. A different front desk person must approve it, with their own authenticator code.
erasure.alreadyOpen: This patient already has an open request.
erasure.reasonRefused: That reason is not on the clinic's list. Nothing was sent.
erasure.patientNotFound: This patient could not be found at this clinic. Nothing was sent.
erasure.erasesBody: Erasing removes the patient's encrypted name, date of birth and phone number. There is no way to bring them back from this screen.
erasure.keepsBody: It keeps the request and its audit rows (they are never deleted), the patient's record number, and the keyed fingerprints used for matching, which ignore an erased record. Messages are not erased by this step.
erasure.cancelBody: Cancelling closes the request. Nothing is erased.
erasure.codeHint: You will be asked for a fresh authenticator code.
erasure.approveConflict: This cannot be approved now (the patient may be part of a live merge, or the request changed). Nothing was erased.
erasure.cancelConflict: This request cannot be cancelled now. Nothing was changed.
erasure.approveForbidden: You cannot approve this request (you may be the person who asked, or not front desk of this clinic). Nothing was erased.
erasure.cancelForbidden: You cannot cancel this request (it may no longer be open). Nothing was changed.
erasure.nothingNew: Nothing new was done: the request was already decided or is no longer open.
